title: Spicy Barbecue Coleslaw with Horseradish
changes_from_base: Horseradish, cayenne and Worcestershire make a peppery barbecue-style dressing, and the cabbage is wilted quickly in the microwave instead of salted.
summary: A creamy, peppery coleslaw with a horseradish and cayenne kick, made for barbecues and grilled meat.
equipment: large microwave-safe bowl with plate or lid

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Soften the cabbage
steps.text: Toss the cabbage with the sugar and 0.5 tsp salt, cover and microwave 3 min until just starting to wilt. Cool 5 min.

steps.title: Squeeze
steps.text: Wrap half the cabbage in the tea towel and twist hard to wring out the water. Repeat with the rest.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, horseradish, Worcestershire, garlic, mustard, cayenne, pepper and remaining salt in the large bowl.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Stir in the cabbage and carrots and chill at least 1 hour before serving with barbecued food.

tips: Squeeze the cabbage hard in the towel; it is the key to a slaw that stays creamy.
Adjust the cayenne to suit your crowd.
Make it a few hours ahead so the flavours meld.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; stir before serving. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
